note: Chinese meanings are original rewrites in a modern reflective tone, based on Waite (1910/1911) and common modern RWS readings. Reversed meanings follow modern convention and often differ from Waite's own; his English text is kept under source for traceability. element is set for minor arcana only (suit element); major arcana left null because attributions vary by tradition. image_prompt holds a scene description per card; combine with the shared style prefix before use.

cards.meaning_upright: 站在新階段的起點，帶著輕盈與好奇往前走。這張牌邀請你暫時放下過多的算計，相信自己能邊走邊學。它提醒的是勇氣，而不是保證結果。
cards.meaning_reversed: 可能是衝動行事而沒想清楚後果，也可能是因為害怕而遲遲不敢踏出第一步。值得問問自己：現在的猶豫，是謹慎還是逃避？
cards.image_prompt: A young woman with long flowing hair and a flower crown, eyes closed and face tilted up, stepping lightly toward the edge of a cliff with arms open. She wears a flowing cream dress with gold embroidery and carries a small leather satchel. A small white dog leaps playfully at her feet. Night sky with a large golden crescent moon, scattered stars, distant mountains and a winding river glowing in the valley below.

source.work: The Pictorial Key to the Tarot, A. E. Waite (1910/1911)
source.waite_upright_en: Folly, mania, extravagance, intoxication, delirium, frenzy, bewrayment.
source.waite_reversed_en: Negligence, absence, distribution, carelessness, apathy, nullity, vanity.

cards.review_note: 韋特原文正位為 folly, mania（愚蠢、瘋狂），這裡採現代的新開始解讀。

cards.meaning_upright: 你手邊其實已經有需要的工具與才能，這張牌提醒你把注意力聚焦，把想法轉成行動。當意志與行動一致時，你有能力讓事情成形。
cards.meaning_reversed: 資源或才華沒有被好好運用，或是專注力被分散了。也可能提醒你留意話語與行動是否一致，避免只靠包裝而缺少真誠。
cards.image_prompt: A robed magician standing behind a wooden altar-table, one hand raised high holding a glowing wand toward the sky, the other pointing down toward the earth. On the table lie a golden cup, a sword, a coin engraved with a star and a second wand, one of each. A glowing sideways figure-eight of light floats above the head. Red roses and white lilies bloom around the table, dark star-filled sky behind.

source.work: The Pictorial Key to the Tarot, A. E. Waite (1910/1911)
source.waite_upright_en: Skill, diplomacy, address, subtlety; sickness, pain, loss, disaster, snares of enemies; self-confidence, will; the Querent, if male.
source.waite_reversed_en: Physician, Magus, mental disease, disgrace, disquiet.

cards.meaning_upright: 答案也許還沒有浮現，現在適合安靜下來，傾聽內在的聲音。這張牌提醒你，有些事不必急著弄清楚，先觀察、先感受。
cards.meaning_reversed: 可能是太依賴表面的資訊，而忽略了內心真正的感受；也可能有些事被隱藏或沒有說出口。值得問問自己：你是在聽直覺，還是在聽雜音？
cards.image_prompt: A serene woman in a flowing blue robe seated between two tall stone pillars, one black and one pale, with a veil of pomegranates hanging between them. A silver crescent moon rests at her feet, a tall lunar crown on her head, a partly hidden scroll in her lap. The hem of her robe turns into rippling water. Quiet, mysterious, moonlit atmosphere.

source.work: The Pictorial Key to the Tarot, A. E. Waite (1910/1911)
source.waite_upright_en: Secrets, mystery, the future as yet unrevealed; the woman who interests the Querent, if male; the Querent herself, if female; silence, tenacity; mystery, wisdom, science.
source.waite_reversed_en: Passion, moral or physical ardour, conceit, surface knowledge.

cards.meaning_upright: 與豐盛、照顧和創造有關的能量。這張牌鼓勵你滋養自己與身邊的人，也享受生活中美好的事物，讓想法慢慢長成果實。
cards.meaning_reversed: 照顧別人的同時忽略了自己，或是創造力暫時卡住。也可能是過度保護或過度依賴，值得想想：付出與接受之間是否失去了平衡？
cards.image_prompt: A gentle empress seated on a cushioned throne in a golden wheat field, wearing a crown of twelve small stars and a flowing gown patterned with pomegranates. A heart-shaped shield rests beside her and a short scepter in her hand. Lush forest and a small waterfall behind, warm glowing light, abundant and nurturing mood.

source.work: The Pictorial Key to the Tarot, A. E. Waite (1910/1911)
source.waite_upright_en: Fruitfulness, action, initiative, length of days; the unknown, clandestine; also difficulty, doubt, ignorance.
source.waite_reversed_en: Light, truth, the unravelling of involved matters, public rejoicings; according to another reading, vacillation.

cards.meaning_upright: 代表建立秩序、承擔責任的力量。這張牌提醒你，用清楚的規則與界線，為想做的事打下穩固的基礎。
cards.meaning_reversed: 權威可能變成固執或控制，也可能是缺乏規劃與紀律，讓事情失去結構。值得檢視：你是在帶領，還是在支配？
cards.image_prompt: A stern emperor seated on a heavy stone throne carved with ram heads, wearing a red robe over steel armor, a golden crown, holding an ankh-topped scepter in one hand and a golden orb in the other. Behind him bare, rocky mountains and a thin winding river under a dark orange-tinted sky. Authority and structure.

source.work: The Pictorial Key to the Tarot, A. E. Waite (1910/1911)
source.waite_upright_en: Stability, power, protection, realization; a great person; aid, reason, conviction; also authority and will.
source.waite_reversed_en: Benevolence, compassion, credit; also confusion to enemies, obstruction, immaturity.

cards.meaning_upright: 與傳統、學習和共同信念有關。你可能正在向可靠的前輩或既有的制度尋求指引，這張牌肯定經驗與傳承的價值。
cards.meaning_reversed: 是時候質疑既有的規則，找出適合自己的做法；也提醒你不要只是因為大家都這樣，就盲目遵從。
cards.image_prompt: A hierophant in rich ceremonial robes seated between two stone pillars, wearing a triple-tiered crown, one hand raised in blessing and the other holding a tall triple-crossed staff. Two crossed keys lie at his feet, two small kneeling figures in robes before him. Calm sacred hall lit by warm gold light.

source.work: The Pictorial Key to the Tarot, A. E. Waite (1910/1911)
source.waite_upright_en: Marriage, alliance, captivity, servitude; by another account, mercy and goodness; inspiration; the man to whom the Querent has recourse.
source.waite_reversed_en: Society, good understanding, concord, overkindness, weakness.

cards.review_note: 韋特原文正位偏向 marriage, alliance, captivity, servitude（婚姻、結盟、束縛），這裡採現代的傳統與指引解讀。

cards.meaning_upright: 這張牌談的不只是愛情，更是依照自己的價值做出真心的選擇。你可能正面對一個需要誠實面對自己的決定，或一段重要的關係。
cards.meaning_reversed: 價值觀或期待出現落差，或是在選擇面前猶豫、逃避。值得問問自己：真正想要的是什麼？彼此是否都足夠坦誠？
cards.image_prompt: Two figures in flowing robes standing apart in a lush garden under a huge radiant angel with red wings floating in the clouds above them, hands outstretched in blessing. Behind the woman a tree with fruit and a coiled serpent; behind the man a tree with flame-like leaves. A tall mountain glows between them in the distance. Tender, romantic, modest.

source.work: The Pictorial Key to the Tarot, A. E. Waite (1910/1911)
source.waite_upright_en: Attraction, love, beauty, trials overcome.
source.waite_reversed_en: Failure, foolish designs. Another account speaks of marriage frustrated and contrarieties of all kinds.

cards.meaning_upright: 你正在以堅定的意志駕馭相互拉扯的力量，朝目標前進。這張牌提醒你，成功來自把分散的力氣導向同一個方向。
cards.meaning_reversed: 內在或外在的力量互相拉扯，讓你失去方向，或是過於強硬而衝撞身邊的人。先停下來確認要去的地方，再重新握穩韁繩。
cards.image_prompt: A crowned warrior in star-patterned armor standing in a chariot under a canopy of stars, holding a wand, with no reins. Two sphinxes, one black and one white, rest in front of the chariot. A walled city and a river behind. Determined and victorious mood.

source.work: The Pictorial Key to the Tarot, A. E. Waite (1910/1911)
source.waite_upright_en: Succour, providence also war, triumph, presumption, vengeance, trouble.
source.waite_reversed_en: Riot, quarrel, dispute, litigation, defeat.

cards.meaning_upright: 真正的力量不是壓制，而是帶著耐心與溫柔去面對內在的野性。這張牌鼓勵你相信自己有承受困難的能力。
cards.meaning_reversed: 自信暫時動搖，或是用強硬、壓抑的方式處理情緒。可能需要的是接納自己的脆弱，而不是逼自己更用力。
cards.image_prompt: A calm woman in a white gown with a garland of flowers, a glowing sideways figure-eight above her head, gently holding and closing the jaws of a golden lion that bows to her. Soft hills and a distant blue mountain behind. Quiet, gentle strength.

source.work: The Pictorial Key to the Tarot, A. E. Waite (1910/1911)
source.waite_upright_en: Power, energy, action, courage, magnanimity; also complete success and honours.
source.waite_reversed_en: Despotism, abuse if power, weakness, discord, sometimes even disgrace.

cards.meaning_upright: 這是向內探索的時刻。暫時離開喧囂，獨自整理想法，你可能會找到屬於自己的方向。
cards.meaning_reversed: 獨處變成了孤立，或是用封閉來逃避與人接觸。值得想想：你需要的是安靜的整理，還是有人一起面對？
cards.image_prompt: An old hooded figure in a long gray cloak standing alone on a snowy mountain peak under a night sky, holding a lantern that glows with a six-pointed star, and a tall staff in the other hand. Deep, silent landscape with distant cold peaks. Solitary and wise.

source.work: The Pictorial Key to the Tarot, A. E. Waite (1910/1911)
source.waite_upright_en: Prudence, circumspection; also and especially treason, dissimulation, roguery, corruption.
source.waite_reversed_en: Concealment, disguise, policy, fear, unreasoned caution.

cards.review_note: 韋特原文正位含 treason, dissimulation, roguery, corruption（背叛、欺瞞、無賴、腐敗），與現代的內省解讀差異很大。

cards.meaning_upright: 事情正在轉動，沒有任何狀態會永遠不變。這張牌提醒你順應週期，在變化中看見新的機會。
cards.meaning_reversed: 可能覺得事情不如預期、運氣不佳，或一再重複同樣的模式。值得留意：哪些是外在的變動，哪些是自己能調整的部分？
cards.image_prompt: A great golden wheel floating in a swirling sky, ringed with abstract alchemical glyphs (no readable letters). On top a seated sphinx holding a sword, on the right a jackal-headed figure rising, on the left a serpent sinking. In the four corners of the cloud four winged beings, an angel, an eagle, a bull and a lion, each reading an open book.

source.work: The Pictorial Key to the Tarot, A. E. Waite (1910/1911)
source.waite_upright_en: Destiny, fortune, success, elevation, luck, felicity.
source.waite_reversed_en: Increase, abundance, superfluity.

cards.meaning_upright: 事情會被誠實地衡量。這張牌提醒你依事實做出公平的判斷，並為自己的選擇負責。
cards.meaning_reversed: 可能遇到不公平的對待，或是自己帶著偏見、逃避責任。值得重新審視：自己是否看清了全部的事實？
cards.image_prompt: A crowned figure in red robes seated on a throne between two stone pillars with a purple veil behind, holding an upright sword in the right hand and a pair of balanced scales in the left. Solemn, fair, quiet atmosphere with a soft glow around the scales.

source.work: The Pictorial Key to the Tarot, A. E. Waite (1910/1911)
source.waite_upright_en: Equity, rightness, probity, executive; triumph of the deserving side in law.
source.waite_reversed_en: Law in all its departments, legal complications, bigotry, bias, excessive severity.

cards.meaning_upright: 有時候停下來，反而能看到不同的風景。這張牌邀請你放下急著要結果的心，用新的角度理解眼前的處境。
cards.meaning_reversed: 停滯可能不是在醞釀，而是在拖延；或是付出了很多卻沒有意義的犧牲。值得問問自己：你是在等待時機，還是在躲避決定？
cards.image_prompt: A figure hanging upside down by one foot from a living, leafy T-shaped tree, the other leg bent behind, hands tied behind the back, with a calm peaceful face and a golden halo around the head. Pale dawn sky behind. Suspended, serene, still.

source.work: The Pictorial Key to the Tarot, A. E. Waite (1910/1911)
source.waite_upright_en: Wisdom, circumspection, discernment, trials, sacrifice, intuition, divination, prophecy.
source.waite_reversed_en: Selfishness, the crowd, body politic.

cards.meaning_upright: 這張牌很少代表字面上的死亡，而是某個階段的結束。放下已經完成使命的事物，才有空間迎接新的開始。
cards.meaning_reversed: 不願放手，讓轉變卡在半路。值得留意：你緊抓不放的是什麼？放下之後又會發生什麼？
cards.image_prompt: A skeleton knight in black armor riding a white horse and carrying a black banner with a white rose. Before him a fallen king, a praying bishop in tall hat, a kneeling child and a maiden. In the far background a river and the sun rising between two tall towers. Solemn but hopeful.

source.work: The Pictorial Key to the Tarot, A. E. Waite (1910/1911)
source.waite_upright_en: End, mortality, destruction, corruption also, for a man, the loss of a benefactor for a woman, many contrarieties; for a maid, failure of marriage projects.
source.waite_reversed_en: Inertia, sleep, lethargy, petrifaction, somnambulism; hope destroyed.

cards.review_note: 韋特原文正位偏向 end, mortality, destruction（終結、必死、毀壞），這裡改為轉變與重生的語氣。

cards.meaning_upright: 在不同的力量之間找到適當的比例。這張牌提醒你放慢腳步，用耐心與節制，慢慢調和生活的各個面向。
cards.meaning_reversed: 生活或情緒走向某個極端，或是操之過急。可以想想：哪一部分過多、哪一部分被忽略了？
cards.image_prompt: A tall winged angel with a golden halo, one foot on land and one foot in a calm pond, pouring water between two cups. A winding path leads to distant mountains with a glowing golden crown of light above them. Irises bloom at the water's edge. Balanced, soft, flowing.

source.work: The Pictorial Key to the Tarot, A. E. Waite (1910/1911)
source.waite_upright_en: Economy, moderation, frugality, management, accommodation.
source.waite_reversed_en: Things connected with churches, religions, sects, the priesthood, sometimes even the priest who will marry the Querent; also disunion, unfortunate combinations, competing interests.

cards.meaning_upright: 這張牌提醒你留意那些讓你感到被綁住的東西，可能是習慣、慾望或恐懼。很多束縛其實是鬆動的，看見它，就是第一步。
cards.meaning_reversed: 你開始覺察並試著擺脫某種依賴或限制，過程可能不輕鬆，但這是重新取回自主權的時刻。
cards.image_prompt: A horned, bat-winged goat-headed figure squatting on a black stone pedestal, holding an upward torch, with an inverted fiery star above. Two small horned and tailed figures chained loosely at the neck at its feet, the chains are slack enough to slip off. Dark red-black cave, ominous but subtle.

source.work: The Pictorial Key to the Tarot, A. E. Waite (1910/1911)
source.waite_upright_en: Ravage, violence, vehemence, extraordinary efforts, force, fatality; that which is predestined but is not for this reason evil.
source.waite_reversed_en: Evil fatality, weakness, pettiness, blindness.

cards.review_note: 韋特原文正位為 ravage, violence, fatality（破壞、暴力、宿命），這裡改為執著與束縛的現代解讀。

cards.meaning_upright: 建立在不穩基礎上的東西突然崩塌。這張牌很震撼，卻也常帶來真相與釋放，讓你有機會重新蓋得更穩固。
cards.meaning_reversed: 可能是在避免一場該發生的改變，或是正走在變動之後的餘波裡。值得想想：哪個已經搖晃的結構，你還在勉強撐著？
cards.image_prompt: A tall stone tower on a cliff struck by a bolt of lightning, the crown at the top blown off and flames bursting from the windows. Two figures falling headfirst through the dark sky, glowing sparks falling like rain. Dramatic, stormy, black sky.

source.work: The Pictorial Key to the Tarot, A. E. Waite (1910/1911)
source.waite_upright_en: Misery, distress, indigence, adversity, calamity, disgrace, deception, ruin. It is a card in particular of unforeseen catastrophe.
source.waite_reversed_en: According to one account, the same in a lesser degree also oppression, imprisonment, tyranny.

cards.review_note: 韋特原文正位為 misery, distress, ruin（悲慘、困苦、毀滅），這裡保留衝擊感，但加入揭露與重建的角度。

cards.meaning_upright: 風暴之後的寧靜與希望。這張牌提醒你，療癒正在發生，保持開放與信任，會看見前方的亮光。
cards.meaning_reversed: 可能感到失望，或對未來缺乏信心。這時需要的不是更用力，而是先好好休息，慢慢找回對自己的信任。
cards.image_prompt: A woman kneeling at the edge of a quiet pool, pouring water from two jugs, one onto the land and one into the pool, glowing sparkles. Above her one very large eight-pointed golden star surrounded by seven smaller stars, a bird in a tree nearby. Peaceful, hopeful, calm night.

source.work: The Pictorial Key to the Tarot, A. E. Waite (1910/1911)
source.waite_upright_en: Loss, theft, privation, abandonment; another reading says-hope and bright prospects,
source.waite_reversed_en: Arrogance, haughtiness, impotence.

cards.review_note: 韋特原文正位為 loss, theft, privation, abandonment，但也記下另一種說法 hope and bright prospects，這裡採後者與現代解讀。

cards.meaning_upright: 光線不明，事情看起來並不如表面。這張牌提醒你，目前的不安或困惑可能混入了想像，先別急著下結論。
cards.meaning_reversed: 迷霧開始散去，隱藏的事情逐漸清楚；也可能是仍困在混亂裡，需要把恐懼說出口。
cards.image_prompt: A full moon with a serene face shining between two tall stone towers, drops of golden light falling. A dog and a wolf howling at the moon from either side of a winding path, a crayfish crawling out of a dark pool in the foreground. The path leads to distant mountains. Dreamy, uncertain.

source.work: The Pictorial Key to the Tarot, A. E. Waite (1910/1911)
source.waite_upright_en: Hidden enemies, danger, calumny, darkness, terror, deception, occult forces, error.
source.waite_reversed_en: Instability, inconstancy, silence, lesser degrees of deception and error.

cards.meaning_upright: 一個充滿光亮與正能量的時刻。這張牌代表單純的快樂、清楚的方向，以及值得好好享受的成果。
cards.meaning_reversed: 快樂被暫時遮住，或是期待過高而失望。光並沒有消失，只是需要調整心態，重新看見簡單的美好。
cards.image_prompt: A laughing child with curly hair and a laurel wreath, arms raised joyfully, riding a white horse with gold tack. A long red-orange ribbon streams in the wind. Behind them a huge radiant golden sun with wavy rays fills the upper half of the canvas. Rows of tall sunflowers in the foreground. Warm, joyful, glowing atmosphere, the one card with a lighter golden palette.

source.work: The Pictorial Key to the Tarot, A. E. Waite (1910/1911)
source.waite_upright_en: Material happiness, fortunate marriage, contentment.
source.waite_reversed_en: The same in a lesser sense.

cards.meaning_upright: 回頭檢視走過的路，並聽見內心的召喚。這張牌提醒你，以誠實與寬容整理過去，決定要用什麼樣的自己走向下一階段。
cards.meaning_reversed: 過度自責，或不願面對該做的檢視。也可能是聽見了內在的聲音，卻遲遲不敢回應。
cards.image_prompt: A great angel with golden wings blowing a long trumpet from the clouds, a flag with a cross on the trumpet. Below, men, women and children with gray skin rising from stone coffins on the sea, arms raised toward the sound. Distant snow mountains. Solemn, awakening.

source.work: The Pictorial Key to the Tarot, A. E. Waite (1910/1911)
source.waite_upright_en: Change of position, renewal, outcome. Another account specifies total loss though lawsuit.
source.waite_reversed_en: Weakness, pusillanimity, simplicity; also deliberation, decision, sentence.

cards.meaning_upright: 一個階段圓滿完成。這張牌代表你把過程中學到的整合起來，值得慶祝，也準備好迎接下一段旅程。
cards.meaning_reversed: 離完成只差一步，卻遲遲沒有收尾；或是不確定下一步該往哪裡。值得想想：還缺的那一塊是什麼？
cards.image_prompt: A dancing figure wrapped in a flowing purple scarf, holding a short wand in each hand, surrounded by a large oval wreath of laurel leaves tied with ribbon. In the four corners an angel, an eagle, a bull and a lion among clouds. Celebratory, complete, glowing.

source.work: The Pictorial Key to the Tarot, A. E. Waite (1910/1911)
source.waite_upright_en: Assured success, recompense, voyage, route, emigration, flight, change of place.
source.waite_reversed_en: Inertia, fixity, stagnation, permanence.

cards.meaning_upright: 一股新的衝勁或靈感出現。這是開始新計畫的好時機，把心裡那把火化成具體的行動。
cards.meaning_reversed: 熱情不足或起步遲疑，想法卡在腦中沒有動手。值得想想：是缺靈感，還是缺一個開始的理由？
cards.image_prompt: A hand reaching out of a cloud holding a thick wooden staff that is budding with fresh green leaves, some leaves falling in the air. A distant castle on a hill and a calm river valley below. Rising energy.

source.work: The Pictorial Key to the Tarot, A. E. Waite (1910/1911)
source.waite_upright_en: Creation, invention, enterprise, the powers which result in these; principle, beginning, source; birth, family, origin, and in a sense the virility which is behind them; the starting point of enterprises; according to another account, money, fortune, inheritance.
source.waite_reversed_en: Fall, decadence, ruin, perdition, to perish also a certain clouded joy.

cards.meaning_upright: 你站在已有的成就上，眺望更遠的地方。這張牌提醒你，好好規劃下一步，決定要去哪裡。
cards.meaning_reversed: 擔心風險而不敢踏出舒適圈，或是沒有明確的計畫。值得釐清的是：害怕的是改變，還是不確定？

source.waite_upright_en: The card signifies strength in opposition. If attacked, the person will meet an onslaught boldly; and his build shews, that he may prove a formidable antagonist. With this main significance there are all its possible adjuncts--delay, suspension, adjournment.

source.waite_reversed_en: Great joy, happiness, feasting.

source.waite_reversed_en: Truth, loyalty, liberty; but the readings vary and include mistakes, imperfections, etc.

source.waite_upright_en: Utility, serviceableness, interest, responsibility, rectitude-all on the normal and external plane.
source.waite_reversed_en: inertia, idleness, repose of that kind, stagnation; also placidity, discouragement, carelessness.

cards.meaning_upright: 把溫暖與務實結合起來，營造一個舒適、可靠的環境。這張牌鼓勵你照顧身邊的人，也照顧自己。
cards.meaning_reversed: 把所有事都攬在身上而忽略自己，或是過度重視物質。值得想想：你的付出，有沒有留一點給自己？
cards.image_prompt: A queen on a throne carved with fruit and flowers, in a garden of roses and vines, holding a golden coin in her lap, a small rabbit at her feet. Warm, nurturing.

source.work: The Pictorial Key to the Tarot, A. E. Waite (1910/1911)
source.waite_upright_en: Opulence, generosity, magnificence, security, liberty.
source.waite_reversed_en: Evil, suspicion, suspense, fear, mistrust.

cards.meaning_upright: 以穩健與務實累積成果的領導者。這張牌提醒你，把資源用在長遠的地方，並以可靠的態度對待別人。
cards.meaning_reversed: 過度追求財富與地位，或是固執地不願改變。值得想想：成功之外，你還想要什麼樣的生活？
cards.image_prompt: A king seated on a throne decorated with bulls and grapevines, wearing a robe embroidered with grapes, holding a scepter and a golden coin on his knee. A castle in the background. Prosperous, steady.

source.work: The Pictorial Key to the Tarot, A. E. Waite (1910/1911)
source.waite_upright_en: Valour, realizing intelligence, business and normal intellectual aptitude, sometimes mathematical gifts and attainments of this kind; success in these paths.
source.waite_reversed_en: Vice, weakness, ugliness, perversity, corruption, peril.
